_comment: Published loom-fun cards the nightly gates run on (.github/workflows/nightly-gates.yml). memory_bytes is the card's own loom-serve --memory_bytes; kit is the reference example whose chat_probe the gates need (LOOM_KIT), or null for the starter's; llamacpp is the lemonade-sdk/llamacpp-rocm release the card was measured against (b1355 letterboxes Gemma 4 images: gemma4 needs b1368 or newer). features is what the card's model.json and llm_config.json declare.
